title: recordVerifyInvocation stamps run.verify on the finalise report (FBS-217)
description: describeInvocation projects the detected invocation onto run.verify { command, prefixArgs, source, version } (nulls where unknown); the preseed stub carries it before launch and recordVerifyInvocation copies it onto the report verify wrote after the subprocess returns, leaving every verify-stamped field untouched, so the launch-failure record and a completed run both say which verifier ran. formatInvocation prints the same record on the launch line.
